source.text:
2 March 2026
Kestrel Plumbing & Heating Ltd
Our reference: P245650-6

Dear C Barrett,

Enclosed is our invoice for bathroom tap replacement at Studio 77. The total shown opposite is expected by the date shown beside it.

Due date              Sub total     £1,442.67
1 April 2026          VAT           £288.53
                      Total         £1,731.20

Invoice number P245650-6. Tax point 2 March 2026. VAT is charged at the standard rate of 20% and our VAT registration number is shown at the foot of this page.

Please quote the invoice number if you need to contact us. Payment can be made by bank transfer to sort code 98-68-00, account 02578729, using the invoice number as the reference.

Thank you for your business.

Yours sincerely,
Sara Bailey-Dean
Kestrel Plumbing & Heating Ltd
